rows.what: Loadable franchise-free Fever Wood member of the Biomes composition.
rows.called_by: Biomes.compose.json member FeverWood; game def and assembly loader
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: The land, life and signature need their actual loaded definitions and assembly; About metadata alone is not runtime proof.

rows.what: Hand-authored biome identity and inert natural-placement worker.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef workerClass
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Deleting the exclusion would turn a fixed-world biome into a prohibited planet-generation feature. A zero-tile biome is expected, never a failure.

rows.what: Static bole-anchored boughways, bough-soil and wet ground causeways.
rows.called_by: RM_RootCausewayBiomeExtension -> EnvironmentalHazards RM_GenStep_RootCauseways
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Without differentiated usable routes and fertile crown ground this is an ordinary swamp with painted branches, contradicting the selected daily-work root.

rows.what: Marsh refuses heavy construction; completed stilts support it; mirror water is not bridgeable.
rows.called_by: RM_GroundRefusalBiomeExtension -> RM_GenStep_GroundRefusal; ordinary blueprint placement
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Removing real foundation differences removes the reason to establish a branch home. Use vanilla terrain affordances and Bridge ancestry.

rows.what: Broad solid mineable fever trunks and their core anchors; static after excavation in this version.
rows.called_by: RM_LivingBoleBiomeExtension -> shared living-bole placement; mining jobs
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Removing solid giant trunks removes the biome skeleton. Mining stays ordinary terrain/building interaction; regrowth is separately deferred.

rows.what: Still black registered mirror-pool terrain, connected-pool identity and size.
rows.called_by: RM_MirrorPoolBiomeExtension -> RM_GenStep_ScatterPools; TentacleWatch.PoolCells; Tenant.IsRegisteredWater
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Water is the visible boundary beneath the branch routes; deleting it destroys both land and signature. Pool identity is shared by all water callers.

rows.what: Actual water seizure of player pawns and tamed animals, carrying rescue and unresolved loss.
rows.called_by: TheTenant.ScanExposure/Strike and RM_CompTentacleLimb.TickSnare -> BeginRescueWindow
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Nearby companions must have a real chance through normal pathing/carrying; without rescue the explicit November shore-work decision is lost.

rows.what: Standalone mirror-break incident raising agitation and hush.
rows.called_by: RM_FeverWood_MirrorBreak IncidentDef -> shared RM_IncidentWorker_MirrorBreak
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Sentinel and actual encounters already supply the warning. A separate scheduled theatre incident is not necessary land, life or the signature.

rows.what: Consumable mirror-list item, use effect and purchased intelligence overlay.
rows.called_by: RM_FeverWood_MirrorList comps -> RM_CompUseEffect_RevealHazards -> Tenant.RaiseAgitation
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Recommend retiring the duplicate information economy: the core already needs readable current water signs, and buying a consumable adds no essential experience. No deletion is authorised by this proposal.

rows.what: Ordinary feeler, snare, lash, porter and sentinel encounters, finite presence and drive-off.
rows.called_by: TentacleWatch.SpawnEncounter/SpawnEncounterAt -> limb comps
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: The November owner answer explicitly includes tentacle interruptions. Their roles make approach, rescue, warning and response the same system, not independent encounters.

rows.what: Visible slender loot-depositing porter and pool-local grievance after attack.
rows.called_by: RM_CompTentacleLimb.TickPorter/PostPostApplyDamage -> TentacleWatch.OnPorterAttacked
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Without renewed shore temptation and a consequence for attacking the giver, remembering water becomes an arbitrary punishment with no ordinary reason to approach.

rows.what: Large-pool eye encounter and progressively stronger combat relief, ending in map-wide adult defeat.
rows.called_by: TentacleWatch.GreatEmergenceEligible/SpawnGreatEmergence; RM_CompTentacleEye
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: The signature needs a playable response beyond avoidance; the documented eye ladder supplies a decisive endpoint. Removing it leaves permanent danger with no earned resolution.

rows.what: Crafted radioactive treatment, designation, hauling and map-wide adult quiet.
rows.called_by: Designator_FoulPool -> WorkGiver_FoulPool -> JobDriver_FoulPool -> TentacleWatch.SuppressPoolWithRadioactiveMaterial
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: A second, reagent-based response is not required when the combat ladder remains complete. Preserve the ruled reagent and campaign restrictions for its return.

rows.what: Captive tank upkeep, products, teaching benefit and breach/deconstruction outcomes.
rows.called_by: RM_SekkulaathTank -> RM_CompCapturedSpecimen -> TheTenant.Notify_Taught and escaped-young comp
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: The shore loop remains understandable and escapable without a prison industry. Keeping the teaching discount would covertly make the signature depend on a moved economy.

rows.what: Armed escapee travels to water and currently installs an adult immediately.
rows.called_by: CapturedSpecimen.Escape -> EscapedCaptive.Notify_JustEscaped/CompTick -> TentacleWatch.Notify_SekkulaathInstalled
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Only captive industry produces this cycle; defer it with that industry. Its immediate installation contradicts the approved delay and must never run by default.

rows.what: Several-day establishment at a particular pool; only the right poison there intervenes.
rows.called_by: Promised successor to RM_CompEscapedCaptive water-arrival path
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: A future captive consequence, not a second core replenishment system. Preserve the November decision without substituting combat, removal jobs or immediate adult revival.

rows.what: World-held-young census makes water encounters bolder.
rows.called_by: RM_WorldComponent_DeepYoung -> TentacleWatch.EffectiveAmbientMtbHours and WeightOf
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: External trade stock and caravan counts are an independent pressure source; core danger must not secretly depend on an unused captive economy.

rows.what: Peaceful release, reachable water return and durable owed-gift queue.
rows.called_by: CapturedSpecimen release and RM_CompUseEffect_ReleaseYoung -> EscapedCaptive.ArriveReleased -> ScheduleDeepGift
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Returning captive stock is a bargain outside land, ordinary life and the shore loop. Its existing adult-revival side effect is coupling, not need.

rows.what: Campaign Sporefall display stock, goodwill and trade story hooks, claimed in history.
evidence: Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_display_campaign: src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/RUT_BroodRansom_Campaign.xml is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.
rows.called_by: Historical campaign patch claims in record.json; generic RM_DeepYoungKeeperExtension consumers
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Campaign story is not necessary biome content. Lower-tier source is unavailable here, so current installation is unknown; generic support is separately inventoried.

rows.what: Live bait stake designation, nonlethal downing, hauling, restraint and release.
rows.called_by: StakeLure designator -> StunForStaking/HaulToStake workgivers and job -> RM_CompLureStake
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Deliberately attracting factions is a separate wager from living beside water. The shore loop does not call a stake.

rows.what: Delayed hostile fronts converge on bait; pending waves persist.
rows.called_by: RM_CompLureStake -> RM_MapComponent_TwoFrontLure -> raid lords
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Faction raids and their second arrival are a separate encounter engine. Ordinary vanilla raids can still frighten herds without this subsystem.

rows.what: Reactive inland ant-dungeon layout and walls/roof/queen rooms.
rows.called_by: AntHive registration patch -> RM_GenStep_AntHiveDungeon -> RM_HiveLayoutKernel
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Exploring depth is the runner-up signature and loses to the explicitly selected branch-and-shore routine. Earlier retain-under-veto work does not require it in this newly authorised first version.

rows.what: Kurreth notice, alarm, home tether and rally in dungeon encounters.
rows.called_by: Kurreth race extensions -> CreatureBehaviors reaction bus; hive generation and future lure raids
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Without the dungeon there is no first-version encounter that requires its defenders. Preserve race defs and roster assignments, not ambient dungeon alarm processing.

rows.what: Dungeon thornbug herd and return-to-room husbandry.
rows.called_by: GenStep_AntHiveDungeon.PlaceFarm -> MapComponent_AntHive farm return
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: The colony can gather ordinary thornbugs without an ant-owned dungeon farm.

rows.what: Deep bostrach guards, choke homes and worker-dependent feeding.
rows.called_by: GenStep_AntHiveDungeon.PlaceGuards -> MapComponent_AntHive guard food/tether
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: It supplies dungeon depth, not the kept colony life or water signature. No race or art eviction.

rows.what: Alarm-driven temporary resin closing a retreat corridor.
rows.called_by: RM_HiveSealing alarm subscription -> MapComponent_AntHive corridor/resin data
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: A route puzzle inside a dungeon is not the daily branch route system. Caller coupling to the shared alarm bus does not make it necessary.

rows.what: Existing exclusion of kurreth theft, live raid-back, hive parasitism and rite.
rows.called_by: Current lure assault lord disables stealing/kidnapping; no parasite comp/generator placement
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Removing the exclusion would reintroduce already-cut mechanics and a declined rite. This row preserves a boundary, not a new retirement request or a reopened waiver.

rows.what: Dormant glomvar race and owner-kept art references load without a feeding parasite.
rows.called_by: Def loader; RM_Glomvar home-tether/unseen extensions; no located first-version spawner
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Compatibility and retained asset identity remain; no ambient placement or new work is inferred.

rows.what: Normal calm-gated thornbug nectar and drommath sap gathering.
rows.called_by: SapSuckerGuild comps -> EnvironmentalHazards RM_CompGatherableCalmGated -> vanilla gather jobs
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Nectar husbandry is ordinary life as explicitly defined by its safety contract. Deleting fear-gating would violate the thornbug hard ban and erase the reason to shelter a herd.

rows.what: Vaulm seal, drommath swelling and ollareth alarm on damage/mishandling.
rows.called_by: RM_CompSapSuckerRefusal; RM_Patch_SapSuckerMishandle; ollareth RM_CompPlantAlarm
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: The unusual refusal outcomes are independent defenses; ordinary animals and calm-gated products remain without them. Ordinary vanilla retaliation is unaffected.

rows.what: Retained native roster, carrion feeding and bounded bark ambush.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef wildAnimals -> wild spawner; SillochAmbush; ordinary ingestion
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: A bark ambusher and scavenger are the ordinary predator/food-chain roles here; deleting actual bounded ambush leaves a nonfunctional predator, while a roaming chase contradicts the lore.

rows.what: Brathek vanilla tree-eating with its existing switch.
rows.called_by: RM_BrathekBoring.ApplySettings -> race foodType Tree -> vanilla food jobs
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: A wood-feeder needs its food and ordinary feeding, not a bespoke excavation system. Removing tree diet empties this ordinary life niche.

rows.what: Slow visibly advancing galleries through inhabited living heartwood.
rows.called_by: Documented promise; local RM_BrathekBoring only edits Tree foodType
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Changing a colony wall is an independent construction/security system; tree eating remains ordinary life. No player steering promise.

rows.what: Retained chellow, murrelith and skellick, real flight and ordinary murrelith plumage shearing.
evidence: Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_birds: src/RimMandrake/RimProperty/Patches/AnimalTheft/SkellickWildTheft.xml:25 is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.
rows.called_by: Biome roster; bird race flight flags/stats and CompShearable
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Living bird sound and tameable/shearable crown wildlife are ordinary life. Flight is additionally a standing requirement; none of this needs the optional theft engine.

rows.what: Working-crown ambience plus shared water hush authority; individual calls separately missing.
rows.called_by: Biome soundsAmbient; TentacleWatch.Notify_SentinelUp/Down -> CreatureBehaviors SilenceCue
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Without an audible before/after tied to actual water activity the warning cannot be read. Keep the working hum alongside animal calls, never use a recording as their replacement.

rows.what: Oil-boil weather, bonus harvesting, connected ground ignition and forced emergence.
rows.called_by: RM_OilBoil.ApplySettings; weather map component; YieldNow/projectile/fire/lightning hooks -> ForceEmergenceNear
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Weather that adds a fuel-and-fire cycle is a competing signature. Ordinary seep-oil harvesting survives with no bonus or explosive haze.

rows.what: Retained alien plant roster, existing normal harvests and static habitat placement.
rows.called_by: Biome wildPlants; RM_FeverWoodFlora and dedicated plant defs -> vanilla growth/harvest
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Forageable crown and margin plants are ordinary life. Their promised independent terrain/state manipulation is split below, so plain descriptions cannot smuggle in extras.

rows.what: Fever Wood overgrown wreck field and hull/carapace salvage children.
rows.called_by: RM_WreckField_FeverWood register -> Wreckage GenStep; inherited salvage comps
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: A registered salvage opportunity is not necessary to recognise or inhabit this swamp and no kept treatment depends on it. Keep shared Wreckage unchanged.

rows.what: Optional acoustic payload for limbs, core, resin and wrecks.
rows.called_by: FindMod-gated RM_AcousticPayload_FeverWood.xml -> AcousticScanner payload consumer
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: The signature must be readable with ordinary sounds, terrain and messages. A tool-specific catalogue is an optional interaction.

rows.what: Tier-safe base roster and optional campaign dianoga/roster remapping contract.
evidence: Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_tier_mapping: src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_FeverWood.xml:75 is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.

Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_tier_mapping: src/RimStarWars/SWBestiary/Patches/RSW_Sekkulaath_DianogaGiant.xml is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.

Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_tier_mapping: src/RimStarWars/SWBestiary/Patches/RSW_SekkulaathTank_DianogaSwap.xml is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.
rows.called_by: Biome base defs and historical external patches named by record.json
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Franchise-free base is whole; lower tiers may add identity, never be required for the base ecology. Their current source and effective membership are unknown here.

rows.what: Saved effective on/off controls for major features with shipped defaults.
rows.called_by: RM_FeverWoodMod settings UI/ExposeData; shared-owner setting consumers
rows.serves: User control of land, life and signature
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Deleting controls violates the standing Mod Settings ruling. Old toggles often leave active jobs or defs behind; these need effective gates, not cosmetic checkboxes.

rows.what: Existing limb/hive readout methods and validation/kernel selftests.
rows.called_by: validation.py; northstar_site.py; selftest_feverwood.py; Source/SelfTest/FeverWoodFuzz.cs
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Proof support is tooling, not a player bar. Keep it available; extend only the observations the reduced scope needs.

rows.what: Saved kept consequences, especially per-pool grievance and active rescue obligations.
rows.called_by: TheTenant.ExposeData; TentacleWatch.ExposeData; limb PostExposeData
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Without persistence the water forgets attacks and reloading rescues a dying worker for free. Source only saves some watch state; Tenant deadlines/agitation are transient.

rows.what: Weight-dependent mud trapping, self-release and companion extraction without intrinsic damage.
rows.called_by: Documentary promise; inspected GroundRefusal paints terrain only; no located trap consumer
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Static marsh travel and water rescue already make ground work consequential; a separate trapping/escape state machine is not necessary. Preserve harmless trapping when eventually enabled.

rows.what: Lootable broken mirror-side ant ruins distinct from living inland hives.
rows.called_by: Historical amendment; current GenStep fills live chambers only
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Environmental storytelling and another loot site are extras; no broken-hive profile located after generator/source search.

rows.what: Native environmental-water drinking through the owning thirst service.
evidence: Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_native_drinking: src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/Defs/Thirst/RM_Thirst_Need.xml:10 is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.

Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_native_drinking: src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/Source/Thirst/RM_ThirstProvider.cs:46 is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.

Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_native_drinking: src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/Source/Thirst/RM_ThirstUtility.cs is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.

Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_native_drinking: src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/Source/Thirst/RM_ThirstJobs.cs:112 is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.

Historical claim only in design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json, inventory fw_native_drinking: src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/Patches/LiquidTypes/RM_DrinkableTerrain_ForeignTerrains.xml:204 is absent from this checkout; not current evidence.
rows.called_by: Historical FlowWorks RM_Thirst integration in record.json; no local provider source
rows.serves: Life with an active thirst service
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: The November native-water ruling applies. Current provider is unavailable here; absence of a thirst need cannot prove successful drinking. No replacement thirst engine.

rows.what: Living-trunk regrowth, crush warning and toxin-sealed cuts.
rows.called_by: FeverTrunkCore living-bole marker -> EnvironmentalHazards LivingRegrowth
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Static mineable boles still anchor land and rooms; regrowth adds a separate base-maintenance hazard and sealant economy. Disable only this biome profile.

rows.what: Calls emitted by living birds and silenced by active water warning.
rows.called_by: Promised bird call producer; current bird defs lack a located individual-call implementation
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: A constant ambience cannot reveal whether a nearby flock is alive or hush its own calls. The signature needs this existing documentary warning promise to be real.

rows.what: Plennith creates or replenishes fertile bough soil.
rows.called_by: Description only; no custom comp in RM_FeverWoodFlora
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Authored bough-soil already supports ordinary planting; a biological terrain-conversion engine is independent of that land. Keep the plant.

rows.what: Accessible potable cistrel cup using the supported thirst service.
rows.called_by: Documented cistrel role; no local drinkable comp/product; integrate owning thirst service
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Ordinary life must include a safe local drink when thirst is active. Deleting this behaviour leaves the named safe-water plant inert and pushes dependent colonists at lethal pools.

rows.what: Corvath appears only after feeding, as persistent botanical information.
rows.called_by: Description only; no local fed-pool spawn gate
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: A historical botanical indicator is a second information layer; current warning signs and local grievance remain sufficient without it. Keep the plant without the functional promise.

rows.what: Skimmel deliberately disguises trapping sink-mud.
rows.called_by: Description only; no current sink-mud system
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: It depends on the moved mud trap; keep ordinary ground cover without pretending it conceals an active trap.

rows.what: Nubrith emits warm ordinary light.
rows.called_by: RM_Nubrith CompProperties_Glower -> vanilla glow grid
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: This is the ordinary visible living light of the crown, using a vanilla glower; deleting emission leaves the life/land picture of the lamplit crown absent outside colony lamps. No independent light puzzle or economy.

rows.what: Optional skellick property theft, claimed by historical external patch.
evidence: design/concepts/FeverWood/record.json inventory fw_birds; src/RimMandrake/RimProperty is absent from this checkout
rows.called_by: Historical RimProperty patch unavailable in checkout
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Recommend removing this biome-specific promise: it duplicates property theft and supplies no necessary branch or water experience. Keep the bird and do not edit its roster.

rows.what: Bespoke biome arrival letter and flavour exposition.
rows.called_by: Biome RM_BiomeArrivalLetterExtension -> EnvironmentalHazards arrival-letter consumer
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Action-linked warning messages remain core; a one-off welcome letter is not necessary to receive or use those warnings. Current prose also promises cut theft and forbidden heat.

rows.what: Legacy per-biome ambient heat-kind and offset declaration.
rows.called_by: Biome RM_SunHeatExtension -> CreatureBehaviors sun-heat consumer
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Conflicts with the standing geometric Direct Sun ruling. Its effect must be off regardless of any retirement decision; never label the old heat as a future supported option.

rows.what: Routes physically move or reroute as living growth changes the crown.
rows.called_by: Later encroachment-engine promise, no local route-movement implementation located
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Daily routing works with static paths; moving infrastructure is a separate maintenance cycle and already later in sheet.md.

rows.what: Generic display keeper, map generation hook and cask trading support in the RM layer.
rows.called_by: RM_BroodRansom.cs keeper extension, stock generator and map-generation patch; YoungCaskTraders patch
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Generic support is present even though its campaign patch is not; no first-version shore action needs it.

rows.what: Action-linked water warnings, victim loss sign and visible current consequence.
rows.called_by: Existing sentinel messages and watch messages; bare wild Destroy(Vanish) is insufficient
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Without a notice pointing to the actual victim/pool and a readable loss or rescue state, loss is silent and the player cannot act on the signature. This replaces no art and requires no bespoke letter.

rows.what: CreatureBehaviors shared silence reasons, flight/behavior integration and existing settings.
rows.called_by: Biomes composition and corresponding engine consumers
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Use reason-based hush and existing behavior interfaces; do not copy the engine or change global behavior to disable a FeverWood extra.

rows.what: ExplosiveGrowth plant growth, aging and growth-top semantics.
rows.called_by: Biomes composition and corresponding engine consumers
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Its roster includes RM_FeverWood as wet-native; retain shared growth and silent/nonlethal giant-top handling. No bespoke bough rerouting or nectar glut is inferred.

rows.what: EnvironmentalHazards shared local land placement, water strikes/rescue, calm gathering and biome profiles.
rows.called_by: Biomes composition and corresponding engine consumers
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Need land placement, effective water authority, deadlines and ordinary calm gathering; regrowth and mirror-list hooks must decouple by profile, not redesign this engine.

rows.what: Wreckage inherited hull/carapace identities and salvage service.
rows.called_by: Biomes composition and corresponding engine consumers
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Retain dependency for dormant defs; suppress FeverWood field registration behind its own next-version gate rather than altering shared wreckage.

rows.what: Bones ordinary butchery outputs and compatibility.
rows.called_by: Biomes composition and corresponding engine consumers
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Normal corpses/butchery may use its shared output; do not create FeverWood corpse dissolution or a new bone economy.

rows.what: Deliberate offering/noise summons and the expanded provocation pressure model.
evidence: Search: local source and race comps contain no corresponding producer; description/documentary promise is not implementation.
rows.called_by: Documentary promise only; no current local caller located
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Natural encounter pressure and porter grievance already connect approach to escalation. A ritual-like summon and additional trigger channels are independent player actions, so defer them without a first-version summon promise.

rows.what: Grolth lays an acid trail that dissolves corpses independently of eating.
evidence: Search: local source and race comps contain no corresponding producer; description/documentary promise is not implementation.
rows.called_by: Documentary promise only; no current local caller located
rows.why: Designer decision, delegated: Ordinary carrion feeding supplies its life niche; a persistent terrain/acid disposal effect is a separate mechanic described but not wired in the inspected race.
